title: Simplify the post-Yes view to text-only message

requirements.text: Update the post-Yes result view so that after the user clicks “Yes”, the app shows a simple text-only message using the previously mentioned wording (“Found me jiyuu ❤️ , By the way good choice 😘”) and does not display the meme image.

quotes: After sayng yes make it just simple saying just mention before

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the “Yes! 💖” button switches from the question/options view to a result view.
The result view displays the exact message text: “Found me jiyuu ❤️ , By the way good choice 😘”.
The result view does not render any meme image (i.e., no for /assets/generated/valentine-meme.dim_1200x1200.png).
The “No” evasive behavior and the initial Valentine prompt remain unchanged.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Adding new animations or additional interaction flows after clicking “Yes”.
Introducing backend storage, analytics, or any network calls for the post-Yes message.
